scripts.dev: npm run build --workspace packages/shared && npm run build --workspace packages/editor-schema && (npm run dev --workspace apps/server & npm run dev --workspace apps/web & wait)
scripts.build: npm run build --workspace packages/shared && npm run build --workspace packages/editor-schema && npm run build --workspace apps/web && npm run build --workspace apps/server
scripts.typecheck: node scripts/build-if-needed.mjs packages/shared packages/editor-schema && npm run typecheck --workspace apps/server && npm run typecheck --workspace apps/web
scripts.test: node scripts/build-if-needed.mjs packages/shared packages/editor-schema && npm run test --workspace packages/editor-schema && npm run test --workspace apps/server
scripts.test:e2e: node scripts/build-if-needed.mjs packages/shared packages/editor-schema apps/web apps/server && node e2e/ensure-browser.mjs && cd e2e && PLAYWRIGHT_BROWSERS_PATH=0 playwright test
scripts.test:ai: node scripts/build-if-needed.mjs packages/shared packages/editor-schema && npm run test:ai --workspace apps/server
